Health Functional FoodNiacin 100mgMagnesium 94.5mgBiotin 900μgVitamin A 400μgVitamin B1 100mgVitamin B12 500μgVitamin B2 100mgVitamin B6 80mgFolate 600μgPantothenic acid 500mg2 times a day

아드파워 부스터Niacin · Magnesium · Biotin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by 우리바이오(주) · 2 times a day · 2 tablets

This product combines 100mg of Niacin, 94.5mg of Magnesium, 900μg of Biotin, 400μg of Vitamin A, 100mg of Vitamin B1, 500μg of Vitamin B12, 100mg of Vitamin B2, 80mg of Vitamin B6, 600μg of Folate, 500mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (2 tablets): 100mg Niacin, 94.5mg Magnesium, 900μg Biotin, 400μg Vitamin A, 100mg Vitamin B1, 500μg Vitamin B12, 100mg Vitamin B2, 80mg Vitamin B6, 600μg Folate, 500mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 우리바이오(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Magnesium
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

2 times a day2 tablets per servingWith water

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Magnesium · Biotin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
